raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the TV series “Tři chlapi v chalupě” with the user’s request for the “film,” prematurely locking onto the series director (František Filip) and proceeding to find his birthplace. This misidentification of the target work (film vs. TV series) was never corrected or verified, leading to the wrong director and thus the wrong birthplace. The Planner failed to disambiguate and confirm the film version and its director, which would have led to the correct birthplace (Prostějov).
